# Feature: Decoy Jolly — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #39 (Decoy Jolly) from Enemies and Bots before it is used in real levels. Effect: A copy of you that enemies chase instead of you, placed where you stand. Unique: redirects enemy targeting away from the player. Useful: buys a crossing window no movement trick can. Source status in the candidate file is 'revised'; it was revised from human review and is now treated as a trial candidate.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** a copy of you that enemies chase instead of you, placed where you stand.

**So that** buys a crossing window no movement trick can.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Decoy Jolly for the first time in its teaching room (mech-39-decoy-jolly-room). Teaching moment: First room: the decoy pickup stands just before a guarded corridor, but not yet in sight of it. A player who walks through without pausing drops the copy where enemies cannot see it and is chased as normal, which teaches that a decoy only works where it can be seen by what it is meant to distract. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: You carry one decoy in a slot
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Walking over its pickup drops the copy on your current tile as you step off it, so deployment is walking through it, no new key needed
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It lasts 20 moves
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: While it stands, patrollers, chasers and blockers target the decoy tile instead of you

## Edge Cases & Rules

- While it stands, patrollers, chasers and blockers target the decoy tile instead of you
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Decoy Jolly's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-39-decoy-jolly-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/enemies-and-bots.yml mechanic #39.
